title: 电影台词
source: 知乎专栏《80句经典英文电影台词，英语作文最佳素材》 https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/95835257

lines.en: After all, tomorrow is another day!
lines.zh: 不管怎样，明天是新的一天!

lines.en: We become the most familiar strangers.
lines.zh: 我们变成了世上最熟悉的陌生人。

lines.en: Later, respectively, wander and suffer sorrow.
lines.zh: 今后各自曲折，各自悲哀

lines.en: Land is the only thing in the world worth working for, worth fighting for, worth dying for. Because it’s the only thing that lasts.
lines.zh: 土地是世界上唯一值得你去为之工作，为之战斗，为之牺牲的东西。因为它是唯一永恒的东西。

lines.en: I wish I could be more like you.
lines.zh: 我要像你一样就好了。

lines.en: Whatever comes, I'll love you, just as I do now. Until I die.
lines.zh: 无论发生什么事，我都会像现在一样爱你,直到永远。

lines.en: I think it’s hard winning a war with words.
lines.zh: 我认为纸上谈兵没什么作用。

lines.en: I never give anything without expecting something in return. I always get paid.
lines.zh: 我做任何事不过是为了有所回报，我总要得到报酬。

lines.en: In spite of you and me and the whole silly world going to pieces around us, I love you.
lines.zh: 哪怕是世界末日我都会爱着你。

lines.en: Now I find myself in a world which for me is worse than death. A world in which there is no place for me.
lines.zh: 现在我发现自己活在一个比死还要痛苦的世界，一个无我容身之处的世界。

lines.en: You’re throwing away happiness with both hands, and reaching out for something that will never make you happy.
lines.zh: 你把自己的幸福拱手相让，去追求一些根本不会让你幸福的东西。

lines.en: The higher I got, the more amazed I was by the view.
lines.zh: 我爬得越高，眼前的风景便愈发迷人。

lines.en: Sometimes a little discomfort in the beginning can save a whole lot of pain down the road.
lines.zh: 有时起初的隐忍可以避免一路的疼痛。

lines.en: One’s character is set at an early age. I’d hate to see you swim out so far you can’t swim back.
lines.zh: 从小看到老，我可不愿看到你做边城浪子回不了头。

lines.en: The apple doesn’t fall far from the tree.
lines.zh: 树上掉下的苹果它落的地离树能有多远？

lines.en: And I realized Garrett was right about one thing: I had flipped. Completely.
lines.zh: 我意识到加利特一件事是说对了：我心动了。完全心动了。

lines.en: Some of us get dipped in flat, some in satin, some in gloss. But every once in a while you find someone who’s iridescent, and when you do, nothing will ever compare.
lines.zh: 有人住高楼，有人在深沟，有人光万丈，有人一身锈，世人万千种，浮云莫去求，斯人若彩虹，遇上方知有。

lines.en: The way she talked about what it felt like to be up in that tree to be held above the earth, brushed by the wind.
lines.zh: 她说起那种置身树梢的感觉时说就像被高高举起，微风拂面。

lines.en: Some days the sunsets would be purple and pink. And some days they were a blazing orange setting fire to the clouds on the horizon. It was during one of those sunsets that my father’s idea of the whole being greater than the sum of its parts moved from my head to my heart.
lines.zh: 有时落日泛起紫红的余晖，有时散发出橘红色的火光燃起天边的晚霞。在这绚烂的日落景象中，我慢慢领悟了父亲所说的整体胜于局部总和的道理。

lines.en: A painting is more than the sum of its parts. A cow by itself is just a cow. A meadow by itself is just grass, flowers. And the sun peeking through the trees is just a beam of light. But you put them all together and it can be magic.
lines.zh: 一幅画不是众多物件简单拼凑而成的。牛只是一头牛，草地也只有青草和鲜花，而穿过树枝的阳光也仅仅只是一束光，但如果将它们放到一起，就会产生魔一般的魅力。

lines.en: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.
lines.zh: 人类生在地球， 但绝不应该在这里灭亡。

lines.en: We used to look up at the sky and wonder at our place in the stars, now we just look down and worry about our place in the dirt.
lines.zh: 我们曾经仰望星空，思考我们在宇宙中的位置，而现在我们只会低着头，担心如何在这片土地上活下去。

lines.en: Do not go gentle into that good night. Old age should burn and rave at close of day. Rage, Rage against the dying light.
lines.zh: 不要温和地走进那个良夜。白昼将尽，暮年仍应燃烧咆哮。怒斥吧，怒斥光的消逝。

lines.en: We’ll find a way; we always have.
lines.zh: 我们会找到办法的，我们总有办法。

lines.en: Love is the one thing that transcends time and space.
lines.zh: 只有爱可以穿越时空。

lines.en: We’ve always defined ourselves by the ability to overcome the impossible.
lines.zh: 我们总坚信自己有能力去完成不可能的事情。

lines.en: And we count these moments. These moments when we dare to aim higher, to break barriers, to reach for the stars, to make the unknown known. We count these moments as our proudest achievements.
lines.zh: 我们珍视这些时刻，这些我们敢于追求卓越、突破障碍、探索星空、揭开未知面纱的时刻，我们将这些时刻视为我们最值得骄傲的成就。

lines.en: And that our greatest accomplishments cannot be behind us, because our destiny lies above us.
lines.zh: 那些伟大的成就不能只属于过去，因为我们的命运就在太空。

lines.en: Today is my birthday. And it’s a special one because you once told me that when you came back, we might be the same age. Well, now I’m the same age that you were when you left… and it’d be really great if you came back soon.
lines.zh: 今天是我的生日。这个生日很特殊，因为你当年走的时候说，等你回来的时候我们俩大概就一样大了。现在我已经到了你离开时的年纪…如果你能早点回来就太好了。

lines.en: When you become a parent, one thing becomes really clear. And that’s that you want to make sure your children feel safe.
lines.zh: 当你为人父母了以后，你会非常清楚一件事，那就是你得确保你的孩子有安全感。

lines.en: I don’t know if we each have a destiny, or if we’re all just floating around accident alike on a breeze.
lines.zh: 我不懂，是我们有着各自不同的命运，还是，我们只不过都是在风中，茫然飘荡。

lines.en: Life was a box of chocolates,you never know what you’re gonna get.
lines.zh: 生活就像一盒巧克力，你永远不知道下一块会是什么味道。

lines.en: I don’t think that when people grow up, they will become more broad-minded and can accept everything. Conversely, I think it’s a selecting process, knowing what’s the most important and what’s the least. And then be a simple man.
lines.zh: 我不觉得人的心智成熟是越来越宽容涵盖，什么都可以接受。相反，我觉得那应该是一个逐渐剔除的过程，知道自己最重要的是什么，知道不重要的东西是什么。而后，做一个纯简的人。

lines.en: You got to put the past behind you,before you can move on.
lines.zh: 以往的失意与得意，迷惘与清晰，都显得不那么重要了。

lines.en: If you are ever in trouble, don’t try to be brave, just run, just run away.
lines.zh: 你若遇上麻烦，不要逞强，你就跑，远远跑开。

lines.en: Death is just a part of life, something we’re all destined to do.
lines.zh: 死亡是生命的一部分，是我们注定要做的一件事。

lines.en: We have been through every kind of rain. There is little bitty stinging rain, rain that flew in side ways. And big old fat rain, to come straight up from underneaths .
lines.zh: 我们经历了各种各样的雨，毛毛细雨，飘雨，倾盆大雨，从下往上的雨。

lines.en: You come close ,but you never made it. And if you were gonna make it ,you would have made it before now.
lines.zh: 你差点就成功了，到你不够坚强。如果你成功了就不会出现在这儿了。

lines.en: There’s only so much fortune a man really needs, and the rest is just for showing off.
lines.zh: 人真正需要的财富只有那么一些，剩下的只不过是用来炫耀罢了。

lines.en: Furious anger those who attempt to poison and destroy my brothers.
lines.zh: 那些胆敢残害荼毒我同伴之人，我将向你们大施报复。

lines.en: All the bright, precious things fade so fast.And they don’t come back.
lines.zh: 所有的光鲜靓丽都敌不过时间，并且一去不复返。

lines.en: So we beat on, boats against the current, borne back ceaselessly into the past.
lines.zh: 我们奋力前行，小舟逆水而上，不断地被浪潮推回到过去。

lines.en: Whenever you feel like criticizing any one, just remember that all the people in this world haven’t had the advantages that you’ve had.
lines.zh: 每逢你想要批评任何人的时候，你就记住，这个世界上所有的人，并不是个个都有过你拥有的那些优越条件。

lines.en: It was an age of miracles, it was an age of art, it was an age of excess, and it was an age of satire.
lines.zh: 这是一个奇迹的时代，一个艺术的时代，一个挥金如土的时代，也是一个充满嘲讽的时代。

lines.en: A sense of the fundamental decencies is parceled out unequally at birth.
lines.zh: 人们的善恶感一生下来就有差异。

lines.en: Conduct may be founded on the hard rock or the wet marshes, but after a certain point I don’t care what it’s founded on.
lines.zh: 人们的品行有的好像建筑在坚硬的岩石上，有的好像建筑在泥沼里，不过超过一定的限度，我就不在乎它建在什么之上了。

lines.en: There are only the pursued, the pursuing, the busy and the tired.
lines.zh: 世界上只有被追求者和追求者，忙碌者和疲惫者。

lines.en: He had thrown himself into it with a creative passion, adding to it all the time, decking it out with every bright feather that drifted his way. No amount of fire or freshness can challenge what a man will store up in his ghostly heart.
lines.zh: 他怀着一种创造性的情感将自己全身心地投入到它的中间，不断地为它增添内容，用飘浮到他路上的每一根漂亮羽毛去装扮它。有谁知道在一个人的波诡云谲的心里，能蓄下多少火一样的激情和新鲜的念头。

lines.en: So engrossed was she that she had no consciousness of being observed, and one emotion after another crept into her face like objects into a slowly developing picture.
lines.zh: 许多种情感鱼贯似地流露到她的脸上，仿佛正被冲洗着的相纸一点一点地显示出物景那样。

lines.en: She vanished into her rich house, into her rich, full life, leaving Gatsby—nothing.
lines.zh: 她消逝在了她那奢华的房子里，消逝在了她那富裕充实的生活之中，留给盖茨比的——只是无有。

lines.en: When you’re young, happiness is something to be had; as you age, happiness becomes a goal that you chase; now you’ve grown, happiness is a state of mind that you try to understand.
lines.zh: 小时候的快乐是样东西，拥有就幸福；成长时的快乐是个目标，达到就幸福；长大后的快乐是个心态，明白就幸福。

lines.en: You know how everyone’s saying seize the moment? I don’t know, I’m kind of thinking, it’s the other way around, you know, like the moment seizes us.
lines.zh: 你明白为什么人们都说要抓住机会、把握此刻吗？我不明白。我觉得正好相反，是这一刻抓住了我们。

lines.en: I’ve spent the first half of my life acquiring all this crap, and now I’m gonna spend the second half of my life.
lines.zh: 我用前半辈子的时间得到了这些没用的，现在又要用后半辈子来想法设法

lines.en: He can find his way home if he wants to.
lines.zh: 只要他想，哪有找不到路回家的？

lines.en: If you know that’s where you wanna go, you should probably do that early acceptance thing, you know?
lines.zh: 如果你是真的想去那里，你就要早点做好准备工作，知道吗？

lines.en: Let them know you’re a man who knows what he wants goes a long way in this life, all right?
lines.zh: 让他们知道你是一个知道自己想要什么的人对你的人生有很大的帮助。

lines.en: There are billions of us just laying around, not really doing anything. We’ve even pretty good at self-maintenance and reproducing constantly. How evil is that? We’re fucked.
lines.zh: 成千上亿的人只是活着而已，无所事事。我们也很会自我保养，并且能不断繁殖。多么可怕，我们都不再是自我了。

lines.en: You don’t have to listen to your parents after you turn. Especially if they’re not helping you financially.
lines.zh: 十八岁以后你就没有必要听父母的话了，他们不给你钱你就更不用听了。

lines.en: It means you are responsible for you, not your girlfriend, not your mom, not me, you.
lines.zh: 我的意思是你要对自己负责，而不是对你的女朋友，不是对你妈，不是对我，而是对你自己。

lines.en: If you truly take care of you, you will be amazed at how much girls start lining up at your front door.
lines.zh: 如果你真的照顾好自己的心，你会惊讶的发现，不知有多少那样的姑娘在你门前排长队。

lines.en: Life is expensive. You know, you have to be responsible.
lines.zh: 生活很昂贵，你需要负责。

lines.en: We laughed and kept saying"see u soon",but inside we both knew we’d never see each other again.
lines.zh: 我们笑着说再见，却深知再见遥遥无期。

lines.en: Not everybody could sail the ocean, but still we could share this dream.
lines.zh: 不是每个人都能成为销魂的船长，但都可以让梦想远航。

lines.en: It wasn’t what I saw that stopped me, Max. It was what I didn’t see. You understand that?
lines.zh: 阻止了我的脚步的，并不是我所看见的东西，而是我所无法看见的那些东西。你明白么？

lines.en: You are infinite. And on this keys, the music that you can make is infinite.
lines.zh: 音乐是在有限的在琴键上，奏出无限的音乐。

lines.en: Moonlight city. You just couldn’t see an end to it.
lines.zh: 偌大的城市，绵延无尽。

lines.en: You’re never really done as long as you have a good story and some one to tell it to.
lines.zh: 只要你有一个好故事和一个可以倾诉的人，你就永远不会完蛋。

lines.en: In all that sprawling city, there was everything except an end. There was no end.
lines.zh: 连绵不绝的城市，什么都有，除了尽头，没有尽头。

lines.en: All that world is weighing down on me, you don’t even know where it comes to an end, and aren’t you ever just scared of breaking apart at the thought of it? The enormity of living it?
lines.zh: 那个世界好重，压在我身上。你甚至不知道它在哪里结束，你难道从来不为自己生活在无穷选择里而害怕得快崩溃掉吗？

lines.en: You make millions of decisions that mean nothing and then one day your order takes out and it changes your life.
lines.zh: 你每天都在做很多看起来毫无意义的决定，但某天你的某个决定就能改变你的一生。

lines.en: People who truly loved once are far more likely to love again.
lines.zh: 真爱过的人很难再恋爱。

lines.en: I don’t want to be someone that you’re settling for. I don’t want to be someone that anyone settles for.
lines.zh: 我不想要你将就，我也不想成为将就的对象。

lines.en: Destiny is something we’ve invented because we can’t stand the fact that everything that happens is accidental.
lines.zh: 所谓命运不过是托辞，因为我们无法忍受所有事情的发生都是偶然的这样的事实。

lines.en: When you’re attracted to someone it just means that your subconscious is attracted to their subconscious, subconsciously. So what we think of as fate, is just two neuroses knowing they’re a perfect match.
lines.zh: 当你被某个人吸引时，那只是意味着你俩在潜意识里相互吸引。因此,所谓命运，就只不过是两个疯子认为他们自己是天造一对，地设一双。

lines.en: Work hard! Work will save you. Work is the only thing that will see you through this.
lines.zh: 努力工作吧！工作能拯救你。埋头苦干可令你忘记痛楚。

lines.en: Yesterday is history,tomorrow is a mystery. But today is a gift. That is why it is called the present.
lines.zh: 昨天是历史，明天是谜团。但今天是礼物，那就是为什么它被称为present（礼物）。

lines.en: The reason I know this and you don’t is because I’m younger and pure. So I’m more in touch with cosmic forces.
lines.zh: 之所以我知道而你不知道是因为我年幼纯洁, 所以我比较能接触宇宙的力量。

lines.en: You know it’s easier to get killed by a terrorist than get married over the age of 40.
lines.zh: 你知道，女人过了40想出嫁就难了，被恐怖分子杀死都比这容易。

lines.en: What if something had happened to you? What if I couldn’t get to you? What would I have done without you? You’re my family. You’re all I’ve got.
lines.zh: 要是你出了事怎么办？要是我找不到你怎么办？如果没有你我该怎么办？你是我的家人,你是我的一切。
